offensive.name: Momentum Surge
offensive.description: Every casting is a launch — generating free movement, bonus damage with a push, and eventually a full additional action as the momentum of the cast carries directly into the follow-through.

tiers.text: After casting the effect, you may immediately move up to 15 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from any creature.
tiers.card: Move 15 ft free after casting — no opportunity attacks from anyone

tiers.text: Your next melee or spell attack before the end of your turn deals +5d8 bonus damage and forces the target to succeed on a Strength saving throw against your Verum DC or be pushed 10 feet in a direction of your choice.
tiers.card: Your next attack adds +5d8 and a Str save {DC} or they're pushed 10 ft

tiers.text: The free movement increases to 30 feet, and the next action or spell you take can be made as a bonus action if it is 1st level or lower.
tiers.card: Free movement becomes 30 ft · your next 1st-level-or-lower action becomes a bonus action

tiers.text: You gain one additional action on this turn, which may be used to Dash, Disengage, make one weapon attack, or cast a spell of 3rd level or lower. This additional action cannot itself generate another additional action.
tiers.card: One extra action this turn — Dash, Disengage, one attack, or a spell of 3rd or lower

supportive.name: Velocity Field
supportive.description: Reality stretches to match your speed and invites allies to match it too — boosting movement, AC, and eventually letting everyone in range Dash as a bonus action and ignore cover on their ranged attacks.

tiers.text: You and all allies within 10 feet gain +10 feet of movement speed until the end of the round.
tiers.card: You and allies within 10 ft: +10 ft speed until end of the round

tiers.text: Allies within the zone also gain +1 to AC and Dexterity saving throws as the accelerated tempo makes them fractionally harder to pin down.
tiers.card: Also +1 AC and Dex saves inside the zone

tiers.text: The zone expands to 30 feet, and hostile ranged attacks made against creatures inside it are made at disadvantage — the defenders moving through their own accelerated time.
tiers.card: Zone grows to 30 ft · ranged attacks against those inside are at disadvantage

tiers.text: All creatures inside the field may Dash as a bonus action on their turn and take no damage from falling while within the field's radius. Additionally, ranged attacks made from inside the field ignore cover and may curve around obstacles of 5 feet or less.
tiers.card: Everyone inside Dashes as a bonus action and takes no falling damage

supportive.name: Reflex Twist
supportive.description: You move between the ticks of the clock — rerolling saves, seizing the top of initiative, gaining Evasion, and eventually intercepting single-target spells aimed at allies within 30 feet.

tiers.text: You may reroll one Dexterity saving throw or initiative roll made this round, taking the new result.
tiers.card: Reroll one Dex save or initiative roll this round

tiers.text: You may choose to act at the top of the initiative order until the end of your next turn — the Cognition briefly rewriting your position in the sequence of events.
tiers.card: Act at the top of initiative until the end of your next turn

tiers.text: You gain Evasion (on a successful Dex save against a damaging effect, you take no damage; on a failure, you take half). Once per round you may react before a creature's action resolves if you are within 10 feet of them — repositioning, readying a block, or making one melee attack before their action takes effect.
tiers.card: Gain Evasion · 1/round react before a creature's action resolves

tiers.text: Once per round, you may intercept a single-target spell or ability directed at an ally within 30 feet. Choose one: redirect it to another valid target, take its effects yourself, or attempt to nullify it entirely with a contested Dexterity check against the attacker's spellcasting ability check.
tiers.card: 1/round intercept a single-target spell aimed at an ally within 30 ft — redirect, absorb or stop it

supportive.name: Blinding Acceleration
supportive.description: You are not where they are looking — blurring your form, ignoring opportunity attacks, passing through hazard zones untriggered, and eventually moving as a light echo where all attacks against you are made at disadvantage.

tiers.text: You gain blurred movement for 1 round — attackers that rely on sight make attack rolls against you at disadvantage.
tiers.card: Blurred 1 round — sight-based attacks against you at disadvantage

tiers.text: Your movement becomes untraceable for 1 minute — you may move through enemy spaces without provoking opportunity attacks, and creatures do not have the opportunity to ready actions triggered by your movement.
tiers.card: Untraceable 1 min — move through enemy spaces freely, no readied actions trigger

tiers.text: While moving, you are immune to effects that trigger on movement — hazard zones such as Spike Growth, Booming Blade, magical tripwires, and terrain-based traps do not trigger as you pass through them.
tiers.card: Moving no longer triggers anything — Spike Growth, Booming Blade, tripwires all stay quiet

tiers.text: For 1 minute, you move as a light echo: all attacks against you are made at disadvantage; you may move up to half your speed as a reaction to any spell or attack targeting you; and you leave afterimages in each space you vacate — attackers have a 15% chance to miss outright (roll a d20; on a 1–3, the attack hits an afterimage instead).
tiers.card: 1 min as a light echo — all attacks at disadvantage, react to move half your speed from any threat

supportive.name: Fast Steps
supportive.description: You steal moments from the timeline — gaining an extra bonus action, an extra reaction, a condition delay, and eventually Speed-Flicker where you take a Haste action every turn and cannot be surprised.

tiers.text: After casting the effect, you may immediately take one additional bonus action — any bonus action available to you, used before anyone else reacts to what you just did.
tiers.card: One extra bonus action immediately, before anyone can react

tiers.text: Once per round, you may take one additional reaction, even if you have already used your reaction this round.
tiers.card: 1/round take a second reaction even if yours is spent

tiers.text: You may delay the onset of one condition by 1 round — the Speed Cognition buying you a brief window before blindness, paralysis, or even the first failed death saving throw takes hold.
tiers.card: Delay one condition by a round — even a first failed death save

tiers.text: Once per long rest, enter a Speed-Flicker for 1 minute. While active: you take one additional Haste action per turn (attack, Dash, Disengage, or Hide only); you automatically succeed on Dexterity saving throws; and you cannot be surprised, flanked, or caught flat-footed by any means.
tiers.card: 1/long rest Speed-Flicker 1 min — an extra Haste action each turn, auto-succeed Dex saves

complementEffects.name: Kinetic Impact
complementEffects.description: The spell arrives with everything the caster's velocity has been building — pushing the target back and eventually stripping their reaction as the speed of impact disrupts everything that follows.

effect.text: On a hit or failed saving throw against the primary effect, the target is pushed 10 feet in a direction of your choice and must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your Verum DC or be knocked prone.
effect.card: Pushed 10 ft · Str save {DC} or knocked prone

upgrades.text: The push increases to 20 feet, and if the target collides with a solid surface they take 2d6 bludgeoning damage. Creatures that succeed the Strength save still move 5 feet — the momentum partial even on a success.
upgrades.card: Push 20 ft · 2d6 bludgeoning if they hit a surface

upgrades.text: The push increases to 30 feet and the target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw against your Verum DC or also lose their reaction until the start of their next turn — the speed of impact disrupting their ability to respond to anything that follows.
upgrades.card: Push 30 ft · Dex save {DC} or they lose their reaction

complementEffects.name: Slipstream Blessing
complementEffects.description: A fraction of your speed detaches and finds someone who needs it more — granting bonus movement and a free Disengage to one or two allies.

effect.text: When the primary effect resolves, one ally within 30 feet gains bonus movement equal to your proficiency bonus × 5 feet until the start of your next turn. For the same duration, that ally may Disengage as a free action once.
effect.card: An ally within 30 ft gains {PB}×5 ft of movement

upgrades.text: You may apply this benefit to two allies simultaneously, and the bonus movement increases to your proficiency bonus × 10 feet.
Each ally receiving the blessing also gains advantage on the next Dexterity saving throw they make before the effect ends — the borrowed speed making them briefly as elusive as the caster.
upgrades.card: Each also gets advantage on their next Dex save

buff.advantage: the next Dexterity saving throw they make before t

complementEffects.name: Lag Field
complementEffects.description: Speed withdrawn from an area leaves something worse than stillness — enemy movement halved, Dash wasted on a failed save, and eventually ranged attacks from within the field made at disadvantage.

effect.text: When the primary effect hits or a target fails their saving throw, a 20-foot radius around the point of impact becomes a Lag Field until the end of your next turn. Enemy movement speeds are halved, and enemies that attempt to Dash must first succeed on a Dexterity saving throw against your Verum DC or the action is wasted.
effect.card: 20-ft Lag Field at the impact point until your next turn

upgrades.text: The Lag Field persists for 1 minute and its radius increases to 30 feet. Enemies within it cannot take reactions while inside the field, the lag removing their capacity to respond to events they are moving too slowly to anticipate.
upgrades.card: Lasts 1 min · radius 30 ft · no reactions inside it

upgrades.text: The Lag Field inverts ranged attacks from within — creatures inside the field firing outward have their ranged attack rolls made at disadvantage, the lag affecting not just their movement but the velocity of everything they launch. Allies are immune to all Lag Field effects.
upgrades.card: Ranged attacks fired from inside are at disadvantage
